description: Kenya-Hara-inspired white gallery page: near-white ground, hairline dividers, wide-tracked micro labels, serif italic titles, and a masonry curation grid where the exhibited works supply all the color while the UI recedes. query.en: Make a quiet, museum-like gallery page for my studio's poster collection where the works carry all the color.
